overall_worst.defect: Inline code across every docs page is padded but its background is nearly invisible on the light theme. Each code token appears to have loose spaces around it ('Run it ( tsx is', 'app.vendurepos.com .', '( pricesIncludeTax: false )'). The code-dense quick start and plugin setup read as sloppy typesetting, and the tall padded tokens also open up line spacing on phones.
overall_worst.fix: Give inline code a visible tinted background (for example a 6-8% foreground mix) with a 1 px border, or drop the horizontal padding to about 0.2em, so the token reads as a chip rather than spaced-out text.
